sentences.en: Back from the Western Antipodes, there has returned one Christopher Columbus, a man from Liguria, who barely obtained three ships from my sovereigns for the voyage,
sentences.zh: 从西方对跖点归来，克里斯托弗·哥伦布——这位来自利古里亚的人——回到了这里，他费尽周折才从我的君主那里争取到三艘船用于这次航行，

sentences.en: for they had regarded the claims he had been making as utterly fantastical.
sentences.zh: 因为他们曾认为他所宣称的一切简直是天方夜谭。

sentences.en: That was Peter Marta, an Italian humanist who was chaplain at the court of Ferdinand and Isabella, the king of Aragon, the queen of Castile, respectively,
sentences.zh: 那是彼得·马尔塔，一位意大利人文主义者，曾担任斐迪南和伊莎贝拉宫廷的随军牧师，前者是阿拉贡国王，后者是卡斯蒂利亚女王，

sentences.en: who had commissioned this Ligurian man from Genoa, Christopher Columbus, to sail, well, Dominic, to the Indies, to China, to Asia.
sentences.zh: 正是他们委托这位来自热那亚的利古里亚人——克里斯托弗·哥伦布，去航行，嗯，多米尼克，去往印度，去往中国，去往亚洲。

sentences.en: And Columbus comes back from his first voyage across the Atlantic, thinking that he's got to Asia, or at least he has to say that he thinks he's got to Asia,
sentences.zh: 哥伦布结束了首次横跨大西洋的航行归来，他认为自己已经抵达了亚洲，或者至少他必须声称自己认为已经抵达了亚洲，

sentences.en: because that's the entire basis of the contract and the commission, isn't it?
sentences.zh: 因为这正是整个合同和委托的基础，不是吗？

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And that's where we left it in the previous episode.
sentences.zh: 这就是我们在上一集结尾处留下的悬念。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: In our first two episodes, we talked about the background, didn't we, to Columbus's voyages.
sentences.zh: 在前两集里，我们讨论了哥伦布航行的背景，不是吗？

sentences.en: And then the second episode, we talked about voyage number one.
sentences.zh: 然后在第二集，我们讨论了第一次航行。

sentences.en: And you're absolutely right, Tom.
sentences.zh: 你说得完全正确，汤姆。

sentences.en: Does Columbus genuinely believe he's found Asia?
sentences.zh: 哥伦布真的相信他找到了亚洲吗？

sentences.en: I think he does, but there's obviously some slight element of convincing himself, isn't there?
sentences.zh: 我认为他是信的，但显然其中夹杂着一点自我说服的成分，不是吗？

sentences.en: He needs to persuade Ferdinand and Isabella.
sentences.zh: 他需要说服斐迪南和伊莎贝拉。

sentences.en: He needs to persuade all these people who've invested, as we talked about last time, Genoese, sort of bigwigs in the court of the Catholic monarchs, as they're called.
sentences.zh: 他需要说服所有那些投资的人，正如我们上次提到的，那些热那亚人，以及所谓天主教君主宫廷里的权贵们。

sentences.en: They've put up the money for this.
sentences.zh: 他们为这一切提供了资金。

sentences.en: And everybody is expecting they have not done this for the thrill of discovery.
sentences.zh: 每个人都心知肚明，他们做这些可不是为了探索的快感。

sentences.en: They have done this because they want spices and gold from café, from chipangu, as they call it, and from India.
sentences.zh: 他们这样做是因为他们想要从契丹、从他们所说的日本，以及从印度获取香料和黄金。

sentences.en: And Columbus has come back with this formula of the Indies, which is nice and vague.
sentences.zh: 而哥伦布带回了“印度”这个说法，这词用得既巧妙又模糊。

sentences.en: It's sort of hints at islands that are probably off the coast of China.
sentences.zh: 它暗示着那些岛屿可能就在中国海岸附近。

sentences.en: But the interesting thing I would say is that almost everybody – I mean, he was turned down so many times by the Portuguese and the Spanish because they said,
sentences.zh: 但我想说有趣的是，几乎每个人——我的意思是，他曾多次被葡萄牙人和西班牙人拒绝，因为他们说，

sentences.en: it can't be done, we don't believe that you can just sail so quickly to Asia from Europe.
sentences.zh: 这根本做不到，我们不相信你能从欧洲这么快就航行到亚洲。

sentences.en: We just don't believe it's possible.
sentences.zh: 我们就是不相信这可能实现。

sentences.en: And they have been kind of proved right because he hasn't gone to Asia.
sentences.zh: 而他们某种程度上被证明是对的，因为他根本没去成亚洲。

sentences.en: And when he comes back, they think, well, we're still right.
sentences.zh: 当他回来时，他们心想，好吧，我们果然是对的。

sentences.en: He clearly has not been to Asia.
sentences.zh: 他显然没去过亚洲。

sentences.en: I'm reluctant.
sentences.zh: 我不太情愿。

sentences.en: Well, I'm not reluctant.
sentences.zh: 好吧，我倒不介意。

sentences.en: I'm keen to do some cod psychologising.
sentences.zh: 我很乐意做点业余心理分析。

sentences.en: Only someone as driven and self-confident as Columbus could possibly have done what he did.
sentences.zh: 只有像哥伦布这样充满干劲且极度自信的人，才有可能做出他所做的事情。

sentences.en: So do you think that to an extent, he can't possibly carry on being the great explorer unless he has – he cleaves to this conviction that he was right and everyone else was wrong?
sentences.zh: 那么你认为在某种程度上，他是否无法继续作为伟大的探险家，除非他坚持自己是对的而其他人都是错的这一信念？

sentences.en: It's the foundation stone of the entire sense he has of himself.
sentences.zh: 这是他整个自我认知的基石。

sentences.en: We talked before, didn't we, about how he probably isn't university educated, how he's an autodidact who has this tremendous sense of himself as the man of destiny,
sentences.zh: 我们之前讨论过，不是吗？关于他可能没有受过大学教育，他是一个自学成才的人，有着强烈的命运之人的自我意识，

sentences.en: who is tilted against the kind of mainstream media, the establishment.
sentences.zh: 他与主流媒体、与建制派背道而驰。

sentences.en: And psychologically, I think it's impossible for him to back down.
sentences.zh: 从心理学上讲，我认为他不可能退缩。

sentences.en: I don't think he's equipped to say, my goodness, I have come back and I've discovered something absolutely extraordinary.
sentences.zh: 我不认为他有能力说：天哪，我回来后发现了一些绝对非凡的东西。

sentences.en: There is a whole new continent out there.
sentences.zh: 那里有一整块新大陆。

sentences.en: I mean, you mentioned Peter Marta, the great humaniSt.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，你提到了彼得·马尔塔，那位伟大的人文主义者。

sentences.en: He is one of the first people to use the phrase, a new world.
sentences.zh: 他是最早使用“新世界”这个词的人之一。

sentences.en: I think, is it Nova Orbis or something like that?
sentences.zh: 我想，是叫“Nova Orbis”之类的吗？

sentences.en: Lots of people are saying this, and that's an amazing thing.
sentences.zh: 很多人都在这么说，这真是件了不起的事。

sentences.en: And yet the great irony is that Columbus, as you said,
sentences.zh: 然而最大的讽刺是，正如你所说，哥伦布，

sentences.en: psychologically cannot bring himself to face the reality that there is another continent because he has staked everything on this sort of lunatic idea that you can sail across the Atlantic in a matter of a couple of weeks and basically get to the coast of China.
sentences.zh: 在心理上无法面对现实，即存在着另一块大陆，因为他把一切都押在了那个疯狂的想法上：你可以在几周内横跨大西洋，基本上就能到达中国海岸。

sentences.en: And the whole way through this is weird doublethink, not just on the part of Columbus, but on the part of the Spanish monarchs as well.
sentences.zh: 整个过程中存在着一种奇怪的双重思想，不仅是哥伦布，西班牙君主们也是如此。

sentences.en: That on the one hand, they're perfectly happy to kind of cull to the idea that they've discovered Asia.
sentences.zh: 一方面，他们非常乐意顺应他们已经发现亚洲的说法。

sentences.en: But at the same time, they're kind of operating also on the assumption that these are new lands that they can grab.
sentences.zh: 但同时，他们也在假设这些是可以攫取的新土地。

sentences.en: Yes, exactly.
sentences.zh: 是的，没错。

sentences.en: The fact that at the back of the minds of both Ferdinand and Isabella is the possibility that they have discovered, as they see it, Virgin Territory,
sentences.zh: 斐迪南和伊莎贝拉内心深处都意识到，他们可能发现的是他们眼中的“处女地”，

sentences.en: because they start to set diplomatic wheels in motion, don't they, particularly with the papacy?
sentences.zh: 因为他们开始启动外交程序了，不是吗？特别是与教廷的交涉。

sentences.en: They do, exactly.
sentences.zh: 确实，没错。

sentences.en: So as early as the 3rd and 4th of May, 1493, so Columbus has been back basically a matter of weeks.
sentences.zh: 早在1493年5月3日和4日，也就是说哥伦布回来才不过几周，

sentences.en: They get the Pope, Alexander Borgia, to issue an encyclical, a top Pope.
sentences.zh: 他们就让教皇亚历山大·博尔吉亚发布了一道通谕，一位顶级教皇。

sentences.en: Top Pope, very famous Pope.
sentences.zh: 顶级教皇，非常著名的教皇。

sentences.en: So he's a Valencian, isn't he?
sentences.zh: 他是瓦伦西亚人，对吧？

sentences.en: So, you know, he is close to them.
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道，他与他们关系密切。

sentences.en: He issues a papal bull that basically says there is a line down the earth from the, I mean, I'm quoting, from the Arctic Pole, which is in the north, to the Antarctic Pole,
sentences.zh: 他发布了一道教皇诏书，基本上说在地球上划出一条线，从——我是引用——北极点，也就是北方，到南极点，

sentences.en: which is in the south, the line lying at a distance from what we vulgarly call the Azores and Cape Verde, 100 leagues away.
sentences.zh: 也就是南方，这条线距离我们俗称的亚速尔群岛和佛得角100里格。

sentences.en: He says basically everything to the west of that line is fair game for Spain and everything, the implication is that everything to the east of that line.
sentences.zh: 他基本上说这条线以西的一切都是西班牙的囊中之物，而暗示这条线以东的一切，

sentences.en: So that's Africa and the eastern route to India.
sentences.zh: 也就是非洲和通往印度的东部航线，

sentences.en: That's for Portugal.
sentences.zh: 那是属于葡萄牙的。

sentences.en: But as you said, the implication is this is virgin territory.
sentences.zh: 但正如你所说，其暗示这是处女地。

sentences.en: These are lands that can be claimed, people that can be converted to Christians.
sentences.zh: 这些是可以被宣称主权的土地，是可以被转化为基督徒的人民。

sentences.en: In other words, it's not ruled by the emperor of China.
sentences.zh: 换句话说，它不是由中国皇帝统治的。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: They don't want a war with China.
sentences.zh: 他们不想与中国开战。

sentences.en: No, I mean, I would thought even the Pope wouldn't feel that he can give away China.
sentences.zh: 不，我的意思是，我想即使是教皇也不会觉得他能把中国送人。

sentences.en: No, exactly.
sentences.zh: 不，确实如此。

sentences.en: So there is a kind of strange double thing there.
sentences.zh: 所以那里存在着一种奇怪的双重性。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And so the fact that there is this ambivalence, this ambiguity, clearly in a kind of deep sense of uncertainty as to what exactly it is that Columbus has found,
sentences.zh: 因此，这种矛盾心理和模糊性，显然在深层意义上存在着对哥伦布到底发现了什么的不确定性，

sentences.en: means inevitably that there has to be a second voyage.
sentences.zh: 这意味着必然会有第二次航行。

sentences.en: Yes, exactly.
sentences.zh: 是的，没错。

sentences.en: Columbus is planning a second voyage almost straight away.
sentences.zh: 哥伦布几乎立刻就开始计划第二次航行了。

sentences.en: The Catholic monarchs, as they're called, Ferdinand and Isabella, they pay him a pension.
sentences.zh: 被称为天主教君主的斐迪南和伊莎贝拉给了他一笔养老金。

sentences.en: They confirm his titles.
sentences.zh: 他们确认了他的头衔。

sentences.en: So he's a don.
sentences.zh: 所以他成了贵族（Don）。

sentences.en: Yes, exactly.
sentences.zh: 是的，没错。

sentences.en: That's what he's always wanted.
sentences.zh: 那正是他一直想要的。

sentences.en: I mean, that's why he's done this, because he wants status and respectability.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这就是他做这些的原因，因为他想要地位和受人尊敬。

sentences.en: But they also say, right, you should start taking colonists now.
sentences.zh: 但他们也说，好吧，你现在应该开始带殖民者去了。

sentences.en: So what's interesting with this is they're clearly rushing because they are worried about the Portuguese.
sentences.zh: 所以有趣的是，他们显然很匆忙，因为他们担心葡萄牙人。

sentences.en: The Portuguese that are the sort of Premier League explorers and colonizers, the Spanish just are a bit of a rung below.
sentences.zh: 葡萄牙人是那种顶级联赛级别的探险家和殖民者，西班牙人只是稍逊一筹。

sentences.en: So they have to hurry.
sentences.zh: 所以他们必须抓紧。

sentences.en: And Columbus had, when he came back, he'd been taken to Lisbon, hadn't he?
sentences.zh: 而且哥伦布回来时，他被带到了里斯本，不是吗？

sentences.en: He had.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: So the Portuguese know about it.
sentences.zh: 所以葡萄牙人知道这件事。

sentences.en: So there's a slight anxiety about that.
sentences.zh: 因此对此有一点焦虑。

sentences.en: In fact, for all they know, the Portuguese may be sending ships even now.
sentences.zh: 事实上，据他们所知，葡萄牙人可能现在就在派船了。

sentences.en: And there are lots of rumors that are reaching the Spanish that the Portuguese may be about to send expeditions of their own.
sentences.zh: 而且有很多传言传到西班牙人耳中，说葡萄牙人可能正准备派遣他们自己的探险队。

sentences.en: They're not, of course, because the Portuguese are much more interested in the more lucrative route around Africa.
sentences.zh: 当然他们并没有，因为葡萄牙人对绕过非洲那条更有利可图的路线更感兴趣。

sentences.en: But the Spanish king and queen agree that they will pay colonists, basically, to go to this new territory.
sentences.zh: 但西班牙国王和王后同意他们将支付殖民者的费用，基本上是让他们去这片新领土。

sentences.en: So they organize about 1,500 people, almost all of them men.
sentences.zh: 于是他们组织了大约1500人，几乎全是男性。

sentences.en: Queen Isabel doesn't want women to go.
sentences.zh: 伊莎贝拉女王不想让女性去。

sentences.en: She says that women who go, by definition, would be prostitutes.
sentences.zh: 她说去那里的女性，按定义来说，就是妓女。

sentences.en: So she doesn't like the idea of women going.
sentences.zh: 所以她不喜欢女性去的想法。

sentences.en: They are told that they're going to settle.
sentences.zh: 他们被告知他们要去定居。

sentences.en: They're going to look for gold.
sentences.zh: 他们要去寻找黄金。

sentences.en: Columbus has come back talking about gold.
sentences.zh: 哥伦布回来时一直在谈论黄金。

sentences.en: So they're going to establish gold mines.
sentences.zh: 所以他们要去建立金矿。

sentences.en: Now, this is different from what the Portuguese are doing right away.
sentences.zh: 现在，这与葡萄牙人当时的做法不同。

sentences.en: So when the Portuguese go around Africa and when they do their own expeditions, they're really going purely to trade.
sentences.zh: 所以当葡萄牙人绕过非洲进行他们自己的探险时，他们纯粹是为了贸易。

sentences.en: They establish ports.
sentences.zh: 他们建立港口。

sentences.en: They buy slaves.
sentences.zh: 他们购买奴隶。

sentences.en: They buy ivory.
sentences.zh: 他们购买象牙。

sentences.en: They buy gold.
sentences.zh: 他们购买黄金。

sentences.en: But they don't really want to set up little towns of their own, the Portuguese.
sentences.zh: 但葡萄牙人并不真的想建立自己的小城镇。

sentences.en: That's why, you know, when you tell the story of Portuguese colonization in Africa and India, there's no sort of big lumps of Portuguese territory.
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么当你讲述葡萄牙在非洲和印度的殖民故事时，没有那种大块的葡萄牙领土。

sentences.en: They're all just ribbons and on the coaSt.
sentences.zh: 它们都只是海岸线上的一条条丝带。

sentences.en: But the Spanish straight away are thinking, well, maybe we'll build towns and we'll do what we did on the Canary Islands.
sentences.zh: 但西班牙人从一开始就在想，好吧，也许我们会建造城镇，我们会做我们在加那利群岛做过的事情。

sentences.en: We could even have plantations and things.
sentences.zh: 我们甚至可以有种植园之类的东西。

sentences.en: And what they did in Spain itself, in Iberia itself with the Reconquista.
sentences.zh: 还有他们在西班牙本土，在伊比利亚半岛通过收复失地运动所做的事情。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: So they've already, they've got experience of doing this because when they drove back the moors, as they would have called them, they established towns.
sentences.zh: 所以他们已经有了这方面的经验，因为当他们击退摩尔人（他们当时这么称呼）时，他们建立了城镇。

sentences.en: You know, they also converted people.
sentences.zh: 你知道，他们也转化了当地人。

sentences.en: So Isabella in particular is really keen on the idea of conversion.
sentences.zh: 所以伊莎贝拉特别热衷于转化的想法。

sentences.en: There's that tension, which this episode, you know, really brings out between when we get there, the local people, are we going to make them our workforce?
sentences.zh: 存在着那种紧张关系，这一集确实突显了这一点：当我们到达那里时，对于当地人，我们是要把他们变成我们的劳动力吗？

sentences.en: Basically, just force them to become our slaves, effectively.
sentences.zh: 基本上，就是强迫他们成为我们的奴隶，实际上。

sentences.en: Or should we actually be making Spaniards of them?
sentences.zh: 还是我们应该实际上把他们变成西班牙人？

sentences.en: She gives explicit instructions to Columbus that he is to treat the Indians, as they're calling them, very well and lovingly.
sentences.zh: 她给哥伦布明确的指示，要非常友好和充满爱心地对待他们所称的“印第安人”。

sentences.en: That word lovingly, amorosamente, that was a word they had used when they had conquered Granada.
sentences.zh: 那个词“充满爱心地”（amorosamente），那是他们在征服格拉纳达时用过的词。

sentences.en: So that was how they had said, we will treat the population of Granada lovingly.
sentences.zh: 所以那就是他们所说的，我们将充满爱心地对待格拉纳达的人民。

sentences.en: So again, there's that sort of continuity between the Reconquista, because at this very moment that Columbus is coming back and having these conversations with them,
sentences.zh: 所以同样，在收复失地运动之间存在着那种连续性，因为就在哥伦布回来并与他们进行这些对话的这一刻，

sentences.en: they are busy converting the forced conversion of Muslims and Jews to Christianity within Spain.
sentences.zh: 他们正忙于在西班牙境内强迫穆斯林和犹太人改信基督教。

sentences.en: And so this is a year after the conquest of Granada, a year after the expulsion of Jews who refused to convert.
sentences.zh: 所以这是征服格拉纳达一年后，也是驱逐拒绝改信的犹太人一年后。

sentences.en: And so, in a sense, that is the approach that the Spanish kings are bringing to their Muslim and Jewish minorities is also evident in Columbus's expedition,
sentences.zh: 因此，在某种意义上，西班牙国王对他们的穆斯林和犹太少数群体采取的方法，在哥伦布的探险中也很明显，

sentences.en: because he is taking lots of very, very battle-hardened Castilian warriors.
sentences.zh: 因为他带去了许多久经沙场的卡斯蒂利亚战士。

sentences.en: But he is also, for the first time, I mean, he's taking a priest, so he is taking a Catalan friar called Bernardo Bruil.
sentences.zh: 但这也是他第一次带了一位牧师，所以他带了一位名叫贝尔纳多·布里尔的加泰罗尼亚修士。

sentences.en: Yeah, who ends up hating Columbus.
sentences.zh: 是的，他最后恨透了哥伦布。

sentences.en: Yes, he goes, they all go badly off-piste.
sentences.zh: 是的，他去了，他们所有人都偏离了正轨。

sentences.en: But you also have a man who will become very famous, Juan Ponce de Leon, who in due course will discover Florida.
sentences.zh: 但你也有一个后来变得非常有名的人，胡安·庞塞·德莱昂，他后来发现了佛罗里达。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Then go off, and the story is that he's trying to find the fountain of youth.

sentences.en: And he decides to basically go off to Cuba, doesn't he?
sentences.zh: 他决定基本上要去古巴，对吧？

sentences.en: So he sent expeditions into the interior looking for gold, looking for slaves, all of this stuff.
sentences.zh: 所以他派探险队深入内陆寻找黄金、寻找奴隶，所有这些东西。

sentences.en: They're all arguing.
sentences.zh: 他们都在争吵。

sentences.en: They've fallen out a little bit with the locals because they're slaving.
sentences.zh: 他们和当地人闹翻了，因为他们在搞奴隶制。

sentences.en: And in April 1494, so they've been gone almost a year, Columbus says, things are not going well, running out of food.
sentences.zh: 1494年4月，他们已经离开快一年了，哥伦布说，事情进展不顺，食物快吃完了。

sentences.en: The natives aren't trading with us and stuff.
sentences.zh: 当地人也不跟我们交易之类的。

sentences.en: I'll tell you what I'm going to do.
sentences.zh: 我告诉你我要做什么。

sentences.en: I'll go to Cuba, the rest of you stay here and see how things work out.
sentences.zh: 我去古巴，你们其他人留在这里看看情况如何。

sentences.en: Which is, I think, is a very good sign of why Columbus is heartily despised by a lot of the people that he's taken.
sentences.zh: 我认为这很好地说明了为什么哥伦布被他带去的人所鄙视。

sentences.en: He's just such a poor leader and a poor manager of men, I think.
sentences.zh: 我认为他真是一个糟糕的领导者和管理者。

sentences.en: So off he goes to Cuba.
sentences.zh: 于是他出发去了古巴。

sentences.en: Twitter's not working.
sentences.zh: 推特不行了。

sentences.en: I'm going to go to Mars.
sentences.zh: 我要去火星了。

sentences.en: Yes, pretty much.
sentences.zh: 是的，差不多就是这样。

sentences.en: So off he goes to Cuba.
sentences.zh: 于是他出发去了古巴。

sentences.en: And I think we should take a break and we'll find out what happens next after the break.
sentences.zh: 我想我们应该休息一下，休息之后我们再来看看接下来发生了什么。

sentences.en: All right.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: See you then.
sentences.zh: 回头见。

sentences.en: Hello.
sentences.zh: 你好。

sentences.en: Welcome back to The Rest is History.
sentences.zh: 欢迎回到《历史的余味》。

sentences.en: We are sailing off with Columbus to Cuba, where Dominic, rather magnificently, he claims to have seen the footprints of griffins.
sentences.zh: 我们正随哥伦布航行前往古巴，多米尼克在那里非常壮观地声称看到了狮鹫的脚印。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Well, don't forget, he also thinks Cuba is China.
sentences.zh: 别忘了，他还以为古巴是中国。

sentences.en: Well, right, because China's full of griffins.
sentences.zh: 嗯，对，因为中国到处都是狮鹫。

sentences.en: Full of griffins.
sentences.zh: 到处都是狮鹫。

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 绝对是。

sentences.en: Yeah, backed with them.
sentences.zh: 是的，到处都是。

sentences.en: Columbus has left these guys on Hispaniola, where everything's going wrong.
sentences.zh: 哥伦布把这些人留在了伊斯帕尼奥拉岛，那里一切都出了问题。

sentences.en: They've sent back some ships to Spain.
sentences.zh: 他们派了一些船回西班牙。

sentences.en: The Spanish monarchs have been busy doing a deal with the Portuguese called the Treaty of Tordesillas, which is going to definitively divide up the world between them.
sentences.zh: 西班牙君主们一直在忙着与葡萄牙人达成一项名为《托尔德西利亚斯条约》的协议，这将最终瓜分他们之间的世界。

sentences.en: But they say, fine, we'll send some help back to the Caribbean to bail out these guys on Hispaniola.
sentences.zh: 但他们说，好吧，我们会派一些援助回加勒比海，去救助伊斯帕尼奥拉岛上的这些人。

sentences.en: And as you say, meanwhile, Columbus has gone to Cuba because he thinks Cuba is part of the Asian mainland.
sentences.zh: 正如你所说，与此同时，哥伦布去了古巴，因为他认为古巴是亚洲大陆的一部分。

sentences.en: And he wants to investigate it.
sentences.zh: 他想去调查一下。

sentences.en: He finds the footprints of something that he thinks is a griffin.
sentences.zh: 他发现了某种他认为是狮鹫的生物的脚印。

sentences.en: I mean, you know, we talked about that, didn't we, in episode one of the series about the world of the chivalric romances.
sentences.zh: 我是说，你知道，我们在关于骑士浪漫传奇世界系列的第一集里讨论过那个，不是吗？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Amazons, people with no ears, all these wacky ideas that people had about what was out there.
sentences.zh: 亚马逊人、没有耳朵的人，所有这些人们对外界事物产生的古怪想法。

sentences.en: And also the idea that there might be Presta John, a great Christian king, waiting to come to the assistance of the Christians of Europe.
sentences.zh: 还有一种想法，认为可能存在一位伟大的基督教国王——祭司王约翰，正等着来援助欧洲的基督徒。

sentences.en: And one of his crewmen sees a man dressed all in white.
sentences.zh: 他的一名船员看见了一个全身穿白衣的人。

sentences.en: And so Columbus leaps to the obvious conclusion that it must be Presta John.
sentences.zh: 于是哥伦布立刻得出了一个显而易见的结论：那一定是祭司王约翰。

sentences.en: So he's clearly absolutely entered a world of chivalric romance, as you say, and wonders.
sentences.zh: 所以正如你所说，他显然已经完全进入了一个骑士浪漫传奇的世界，并对此感到惊奇。

sentences.en: Columbus, throughout all of this story, is a man under tremendous strain and pressure, strained from his financial backers, from the king and queen of Spain.
sentences.zh: 在整个故事中，哥伦布一直是一个承受着巨大压力的人，来自他的财政支持者，以及西班牙国王和王后的压力。

sentences.en: But also he's a Genoese surrounded by Spaniards who all hate him.
sentences.zh: 而且他还是一个被所有西班牙人憎恨的热那亚人。

sentences.en: Also, sailing across the Atlantic is not a barrel of laughs.
sentences.zh: 此外，横渡大西洋可不是什么轻松愉快的事。

sentences.en: And he doesn't really know where he is.
sentences.zh: 而且他其实根本不知道自己在哪儿。

sentences.en: And everything is defying all his expectations.
sentences.zh: 一切都违背了他的所有预期。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: You know, the great Khan of China is nowhere to be seen.
sentences.zh: 你知道，那位伟大的中国大汗根本不见踪影。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: These people are clearly not Chinese or Japanese.
sentences.zh: 这些人显然既不是中国人也不是日本人。

sentences.en: I think there's an argument that he hasn't lost his wits completely, but he's definitely getting a bit scrambled.
sentences.zh: 我认为有一种观点认为他并没有完全丧失理智，但他的头脑绝对已经有点混乱了。

sentences.en: Slight breakdown.
sentences.zh: 轻微的精神崩溃。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: He makes all his men sign a statement that they have seen the beginning of kind of the Asian continent.
sentences.zh: 他让所有手下签署了一份声明，称他们已经看到了亚洲大陆的开端。

sentences.en: And that if they'd gone further, they would have got to mainland China and met the Chinese emperor and stuff.
sentences.zh: 如果他们继续前进，就能到达中国大陆并见到中国皇帝之类的。

sentences.en: And they sign this sort of contract that if they ever rescind that or contradict it, they will be fined 10,000 Maravedis and they'll have their tongues.
sentences.zh: 他们签署了某种合同，如果以后撤回或反驳这一点，他们将被罚款10,000马拉维迪，并被割掉舌头。

sentences.en: He'll cut their tongues out.
sentences.zh: 他会割掉他们的舌头。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Robust sanctions.
sentences.zh: 严厉的制裁。

sentences.en: And the weird thing is that all the locals are saying, this is definitely not the mainland of Asia.
sentences.zh: 奇怪的是，所有当地人都说，这绝对不是亚洲大陆。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: You know, we know that we live on an island and Columbus just will not have it.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我们知道我们住在岛上，但哥伦布就是不肯接受。

sentences.en: He says, well, they don't know what they're talking about.
sentences.zh: 他说，嗯，他们根本不知道自己在说什么。

sentences.en: Mainstream media conspiracy kind of stuff.
sentences.zh: 这简直就是主流媒体阴谋论那一套。

sentences.en: They're part of the mainstream media.
sentences.zh: 他们是主流媒体的一部分。

sentences.en: They've been brainwashed by the press moguls.
sentences.zh: 他们被媒体大亨洗脑了。

sentences.en: He then goes back to Hispaniola again after faffing around on Cuba.
sentences.zh: 在古巴瞎折腾一番后，他又回到了伊斯帕尼奥拉岛。

sentences.en: He's got dysentery, I think, by now.
sentences.zh: 我想他当时已经患上痢疾了。

sentences.en: So he's ill for five months.
sentences.zh: 所以他病了五个月。

sentences.en: In the history books, there were sort of offhand remarks like, you know, Columbus is bedridden for five months or something.
sentences.zh: 在历史书中，有一些随意的评论，比如，你知道，哥伦布卧床五个月之类的。

sentences.en: That's a pretty long time.
sentences.zh: 那可是相当长的一段时间。

sentences.en: He gets there.
sentences.zh: 他到了那里。

sentences.en: Every time Columbus leaves a small group of people on an island, he returns to find that most of them are dead.
sentences.zh: 每次哥伦布把一小群人留在岛上，回来时总发现他们中的大多数人已经死了。

sentences.en: And in this case, about half of them are dead of syphilis because they've been molesting the locals again.
sentences.zh: 在这种情况下，他们中约有一半人死于梅毒，因为他们又在骚扰当地人了。

sentences.en: And they've caught syphilis from the local population because syphilis is reasonably widespread in the Caribbean, but unknown in Europe.
sentences.zh: 他们从当地人口中感染了梅毒，因为梅毒在加勒比地区相当普遍，但在欧洲却闻所未闻。

sentences.en: And this is more bad news that adds to Columbus's kind of discompopulation.
sentences.zh: 这又是一个坏消息，加剧了哥伦布那种心神不宁的状态。

sentences.en: And it's all very kind of heart of darkness, isn't it?
sentences.zh: 这感觉就像是《黑暗之心》，不是吗？

sentences.en: Oh, yeah.
sentences.zh: 哦，是的。

sentences.en: It's apocalypse now.
sentences.zh: 就像《现代启示录》。

sentences.en: It's white men going mad in tropical jungles.
sentences.zh: 这是白人在热带丛林中发疯。

sentences.en: Yeah, that's a good comparison.
sentences.zh: 是的，这个比喻很贴切。

sentences.en: All that kind of stuff.
sentences.zh: 就是那种感觉。

sentences.en: Because the more, the worse that things go, the worse they behave.
sentences.zh: 因为事情越糟糕，他们的行为就越恶劣。

sentences.en: I think it's fair to say, don't you?
sentences.zh: 我想这样说很公平，你不觉得吗？

sentences.en: Yes, and I wonder also if for Columbus there's the shadow of a kind of theological anxiety because the fact that the Indians, as he calls them, when he sees them,
sentences.zh: 是的，我也在想，对于哥伦布来说，是否有一种神学焦虑的阴影，因为他所见的那些他称之为印第安人的人，

sentences.en: are naked and that this is an Edenic paradise.
sentences.zh: 他们赤身裸体，这仿佛是一个伊甸园般的乐园。

sentences.en: He lives in a fallen world and paradise no longer exists.
sentences.zh: 他生活在一个堕落的世界里，而乐园已不复存在。

sentences.en: I wonder if he's shadowed by a kind of dread that perhaps he is the serpent.
sentences.zh: 我在想，他是否被一种恐惧所笼罩，担心自己可能就是那条蛇。

sentences.en: He has brought evil into paradise.
sentences.zh: 他把邪恶带进了乐园。

sentences.en: I don't know.
sentences.zh: 我不知道。

sentences.en: But the sense that things aren't going well, his whole take that the Indians are peaceable, that they are Edenic, that they kind of embody a pre-lapsarian state.
sentences.zh: 但那种事情进展不顺的感觉，他认为印第安人是和平的、伊甸园式的，他们体现了一种堕落前的状态。

sentences.en: And now everyone is catching syphilis and raping and there are cannibals everywhere.
sentences.zh: 而现在每个人都在感染梅毒、强奸，到处都是食人族。

sentences.en: And, you know, he's had the shits for five months.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，他已经拉了五个月的肚子了。

sentences.en: He's living out the whole doctrine of original sin.
sentences.zh: 他正在亲身实践原罪的全部教义。

sentences.en: And compounded by the fact that he knows that in Spain, the pressure is building, that he has to show results.
sentences.zh: 再加上他知道在西班牙，压力正在增加，他必须拿出成果。

sentences.en: Right, because some of his enemies, including the friar, has gone back, haven't they?
sentences.zh: 对，因为他的一些敌人，包括那位修士，已经回去了，不是吗？

sentences.en: Well, they go back and they say to the king and queen of Spain, Columbus is an absolute waste of space.
sentences.zh: 嗯，他们回去后对西班牙国王和王后说，哥伦布简直是个废物。

sentences.en: He's a terrible manager.
sentences.zh: 他是个糟糕的管理者。

sentences.en: He's chosen the worst town sites imaginable.
sentences.zh: 他选的城镇地址简直烂透了。

sentences.en: But also he is behaving very badly with your Indians.
sentences.zh: 而且他在对待你们的印第安人时表现得非常恶劣。

sentences.en: You see, the Ferdinand and Isabella, the thought that these people are their subjects, they take this very seriously.
sentences.zh: 你看，斐迪南和伊莎贝拉，他们认为这些人是他们的臣民，他们非常认真地对待这一点。

sentences.en: They are very sort of jealous of their own power and status.
sentences.zh: 他们对自己的权力和地位非常敏感。

sentences.en: They absolutely do not want Columbus to carve out an independent realm of his own on the other side of the ocean.
sentences.zh: 他们绝对不希望哥伦布在海洋彼岸开辟一个独立的王国。

sentences.en: It's theirs and these are their people.
sentences.zh: 那是他们的土地，这些人也是他们的人民。

sentences.en: For him to be killing them, raping them, enslaving them.
sentences.zh: 他竟然在杀害、强奸、奴役他们。

sentences.en: Isabella, in particular, is furious about this.
sentences.zh: 尤其是伊莎贝拉，对此感到非常愤怒。

sentences.en: And Columbus doesn't get this at all.
sentences.zh: 而哥伦布根本不明白这一点。

sentences.en: He keeps making this mistake.
sentences.zh: 他一直在犯同样的错误。

sentences.en: So at the beginning of 1495, he's been away now for more than 18 months or 18 months or so.
sentences.zh: 所以到了1495年初，他已经离开超过18个月了，或者差不多18个月。

sentences.en: He still hasn't got any decent amount of gold.
sentences.zh: 他仍然没有得到任何像样的黄金。

sentences.en: He and his brother and a guy called Alonso de Ojeda, they go out across the island of Hispaniola and they're kidnapping Indians in larger and larger numbers.
sentences.zh: 他和他的兄弟以及一个叫阿隆索·德·奥赫达的人，在伊斯帕尼奥拉岛上四处奔走，绑架了越来越多的印第安人。

sentences.en: Sorry, I say Indians.
sentences.zh: 抱歉，我说的是印第安人。

sentences.en: They're obviously not Indians.
sentences.zh: 他们显然不是印第安人。

sentences.en: They're Tainos.
sentences.zh: 他们是泰诺人。

sentences.en: They're kidnapping these people in ever larger numbers and saying, well, they're all cannibals, godless cannibals, so it's fine.
sentences.zh: 他们绑架了越来越多的人，并说，嗯，他们都是食人族，没有信仰的食人族，所以没关系。

sentences.en: So, for example, in February, by that point, he's seized about 1,600 locals and he sends 550 of them home to Castile, thinking, this is great.
sentences.zh: 所以，例如在二月，那时他已经抓了大约1600名当地人，并把其中的550人送回了卡斯蒂利亚，心想，这太棒了。

sentences.en: This is my monetization of my project and I will be rewarded for this.
sentences.zh: 这是我项目的货币化，我一定会因此得到奖励。

sentences.en: About 200 of them die on the voyage.
sentences.zh: 其中约200人在航行中死亡。

sentences.en: I mean, these are awful, awful stories.
sentences.zh: 我是说，这些都是非常可怕的故事。

sentences.en: You know, they've been suffering massive culture shock, disease, they die of cold, they don't have clothes.
sentences.zh: 你知道，他们遭受了巨大的文化冲击、疾病，他们死于寒冷，他们没有衣服穿。

sentences.en: It's just awful.
sentences.zh: 这简直太可怕了。

sentences.en: By the time the rest of them get to Cadiz, about half of them are ill, probably terminally ill.
sentences.zh: 当剩下的人到达加的斯时，大约有一半人病倒了，很可能是绝症。

sentences.en: Isabella is outraged that he's doing this.
sentences.zh: 伊莎贝拉对他这样做感到非常愤怒。

sentences.en: I mean, she doesn't greet these people with delight at all.
sentences.zh: 我是说，她根本没有高兴地迎接这些人。

sentences.en: The kind of the horror of it reverberates down the generations because Las Casas, writing a generation later,
sentences.zh: 这种恐怖感在几代人中回荡，因为拉斯·卡萨斯在几代人后写道，

sentences.en: says that Columbus destroyed two-thirds of the population in this kind of razia.
sentences.zh: 哥伦布在这种突袭中摧毁了三分之二的人口。

sentences.en: Yeah, that's right.
sentences.zh: 是的，没错。

sentences.en: Or Hispaniola.
sentences.zh: 或者说伊斯帕尼奥拉岛的人口。

sentences.en: Well, this is, again, a thing where it depends on the political persuasions of the historian because the issue about whether that's true is really hotly debated.
sentences.zh: 嗯，这又是一个取决于历史学家政治倾向的问题，因为这是否属实的问题一直争论不休。

sentences.en: My sense is that most historians think that's a massive exaggeration.
sentences.zh: 我的感觉是，大多数历史学家认为这是一种巨大的夸大。

sentences.en: They say there weren't enough Spaniards to cause that much damage and that obviously the Tainos do end up dying out.
sentences.zh: 他们说当时没有足够的西班牙人造成那么大的破坏，而且泰诺人显然最终确实灭绝了。

sentences.en: But I think probably most historians would say this is actually because of later disease, smallpox and so on, maybe in the 1500s and 1510s after Columbus is dead.
sentences.zh: 但我认为大多数历史学家可能会说，这实际上是因为后来的疾病，天花等等，可能是在1500年代和1510年代，哥伦布死后。

sentences.en: However, there's no doubt that Columbus causes a lot of damage.
sentences.zh: 然而，毫无疑问，哥伦布造成了很大的破坏。

sentences.en: But again, I mean, it's like it's as with the rapes, the idea that Columbus is pursuing a near genocidal policy isn't kind of woke manufacturing in the 21st century.
sentences.zh: 但再说一次，就像强奸事件一样，认为哥伦布在推行近乎种族灭绝的政策，并不是21世纪那种觉醒派的捏造。

sentences.en: It is deriving from what Spanish writers are saying who are almost contemporary with Columbus.
sentences.zh: 这是源于几乎与哥伦布同时代的西班牙作家的说法。

sentences.en: Although one thing I will say is that Columbus is clearly none of the Spanish are genocidal in the sort of strict meaning of the term.
sentences.zh: 尽管我要说的一点是，哥伦布显然——没有一个西班牙人是严格意义上的种族灭绝主义者。

sentences.en: They absolutely do not want to kill the locals because they want them to live as labour.
sentences.zh: 他们绝对不想杀死当地人，因为他们想让他们作为劳动力生存。

sentences.en: Rather like the Caribs who capture people and keep them, you know, fatten them up and to eat them.
sentences.zh: 就像那些捕获并留住人们的加勒比人一样，你知道，把他们养肥了吃掉。

sentences.en: They're not going to eat them, but they're going to work them.
sentences.zh: 他们不会吃掉他们，但他们会让他们干活。

sentences.en: No, but they keep them, you know, and they keep the women, don't they?
sentences.zh: 不，但他们留住他们，你知道，他们留下了妇女，不是吗？

sentences.en: This is the story that they keep the women and breed them to raise children like livestock.
sentences.zh: 这就是那个故事，他们留下了妇女并繁育她们，像牲畜一样抚养孩子。

sentences.en: The Caribs do or the Spanish.
sentences.zh: 是加勒比人还是西班牙人？

sentences.en: The Caribs do.
sentences.zh: 是加勒比人。

sentences.en: So, again, you know, there's a sense, I mean, one wonders, is this a kind of, I don't know, I don't want to go all Freudian,
sentences.zh: 所以，再说一次，你知道，有一种感觉，我是说，人们会想，这是一种，我不知道，我不想变得太弗洛伊德，

sentences.en: but operating in the subconscious of the Spaniards that they're projecting anxieties about what they are doing onto the Caribs.
sentences.zh: 但在西班牙人的潜意识里，他们是否在把对自己行为的焦虑投射到加勒比人身上？

sentences.en: Oh, that's interesting.
sentences.zh: 哦，那很有趣。

sentences.en: I hadn't thought of it that way.
sentences.zh: 我之前没从那个角度想过。

sentences.en: Maybe.
sentences.zh: 也许吧。

sentences.en: I mean, what's definitely true is that Columbus now really just thinks of the locals.
sentences.zh: 我是说，可以肯定的是，哥伦布现在真的只是把当地人视为……

sentences.en: All that stuff about, oh, they're lovely people, very nice, friendly.
sentences.zh: 所有关于“哦，他们是可爱的人，非常友善”之类的说法。

sentences.en: That's all gone.
sentences.zh: 那一切都消失了。

sentences.en: That is all gone.
sentences.zh: 那一切都消失了。

sentences.en: And this is the ancestor of the encomienda system that the Spanish later institutes in the Caribbean, which is basically all adult Tainos must provide tribute to the Spanish crown,
sentences.zh: 这就是后来西班牙人在加勒比地区建立的监护征赋制的祖先，基本上所有成年泰诺人都必须向西班牙王室缴纳贡品，

sentences.en: largely by work.
sentences.zh: 主要是通过劳动。

sentences.en: So, basically, they'll either hand over gold or they'll hand over cotton or they'll work for you.
sentences.zh: 所以，基本上，他们要么上交黄金，要么上交棉花，要么为你工作。

sentences.en: And when they're paid off, they will be given a disc to wear around their necks as a sign they've paid off their tribute.
sentences.zh: 当他们付清贡品后，会得到一个圆盘挂在脖子上，作为他们已经付清贡品的标志。

sentences.en: And if they don't have this disc, they can be worked to death, basically.
sentences.zh: 如果他们没有这个圆盘，他们基本上就会被劳役至死。

sentences.en: I mean, this is a wholly alien way of understanding how labour should be organised.
sentences.zh: 我是说，这是一种完全陌生的理解劳动组织方式的方法。

sentences.en: I mean, God knows what they think about this.
sentences.zh: 我是说，天知道他们是怎么想的。

sentences.en: We don't have any sources at all, really, to tell us what they think.
sentences.zh: 我们其实根本没有任何资料来告诉我们他们的想法。

sentences.en: But one could assume that they don't like it.
sentences.zh: 但可以推测他们不喜欢这样。

sentences.en: Yeah, but definitely one could.
sentences.zh: 是的，但绝对可以推测。

sentences.en: Their whole world has been turned upside down.
sentences.zh: 他们的整个世界都被颠覆了。

sentences.en: The Spaniards are also, of course, bringing over animals.
sentences.zh: 当然，西班牙人也带来了动物。

sentences.en: So, the Columbian Exchange.
sentences.zh: 所以，哥伦布大交换。

sentences.en: The Columbian Exchange.
sentences.zh: 哥伦布大交换。

sentences.en: Yeah, so they're taking back chilli peppers and squashes and things.
sentences.zh: 是的，所以他们带回了辣椒、南瓜之类的东西。

sentences.en: Pineapples.
sentences.zh: 菠萝。

sentences.en: But they have brought over animals like horses, sheep, rats, that are trampling across the agricultural ecosystem the Tainos have built.
sentences.zh: 但他们带来了马、羊、老鼠等动物，这些动物正在践踏泰诺人建立的农业生态系统。

sentences.en: They're making it impossible for them to continue the sort of horticultural or the hunting, fishing lifestyle that they had previously practised.
sentences.zh: 这使得他们无法继续之前实行的园艺或狩猎、捕鱼的生活方式。

sentences.en: So, that's actually destroying their world.
sentences.zh: 所以，这实际上是在摧毁他们的世界。

sentences.en: The Spanish don't do that, again, they don't do that from genocidal intent.
sentences.zh: 西班牙人这样做，再说一次，他们不是出于种族灭绝的意图。

sentences.en: They were always going to bring their own animals over.
sentences.zh: 他们总是会把自己的动物带过来。

sentences.en: I mean, there's no alternative universe in which they don't.
sentences.zh: 我是说，不存在一个他们不带动物过来的平行宇宙。

sentences.en: But the unanticipated consequence of that is it completely destroys the world on which the locals rely.
sentences.zh: 但其意想不到的后果是，它彻底摧毁了当地人赖以生存的世界。

sentences.en: So, all this is going on.
sentences.zh: 所以，这一切都在发生。

sentences.en: What is happening in Spain?
sentences.zh: 西班牙那边发生了什么？

sentences.en: In Spain, the Catholic monarchs are getting really hot onto the collar about all this.
sentences.zh: 在西班牙，天主教君主们对这一切感到非常焦急。

sentences.en: They realise, basically, they have to sort it all out by about 1495.
sentences.zh: 他们意识到，基本上，他们必须在1495年左右解决所有这些问题。

sentences.en: People keep coming back from the Caribbean and saying it's an absolute shambles.
sentences.zh: 人们不断从加勒比地区回来，说那里简直是一团糟。

sentences.en: Columbus is mad.
sentences.zh: 哥伦布疯了。

sentences.en: He's treating everybody very badly.
sentences.zh: 他对待每个人的方式都很恶劣。

sentences.en: We need to do something about it.
sentences.zh: 我们需要对此采取行动。

sentences.en: First of all, they break his monopoly.
sentences.zh: 首先，他们打破了他的垄断地位。

sentences.en: So, they had given him a monopoly.
sentences.zh: 所以，他们之前确实给了他垄断权。

sentences.en: And then in April 1495, they issue a new decree that basically says anybody now can go.
sentences.zh: 然后在1495年4月，他们颁布了一项新法令，基本上说现在任何人都可以去了。

sentences.en: As long as they promise to follow the rules, you can fit out your own private ventures.
sentences.zh: 只要承诺遵守规则，你就可以筹备自己的私人探险项目。

sentences.en: To use our sort of venture capital, sort of tech pioneer analogy, that's opening up the technology to everybody.
sentences.zh: 用我们那种风险投资、科技先驱的类比来说，这就是向所有人开放这项技术。

sentences.en: You know, if you can raise a ship, if you can raise a crew, if you will do as you're told.
sentences.zh: 你知道，如果你能筹到船，如果你能招到船员，只要你愿意听从指挥。

sentences.en: You can set up your own search engine.
sentences.zh: 你就可以建立自己的搜索引擎。

sentences.en: Yes, exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错，正是如此。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 确实。

sentences.en: They send an official called Juan Aguado off to Hispaniola at the end of 1495.
sentences.zh: 1495年底，他们派了一位名叫胡安·阿瓜多的官员前往伊斯帕尼奥拉岛。

sentences.en: And he is told, you know, find out what's going on.
sentences.zh: 并告诉他，去弄清楚到底发生了什么。

sentences.en: Tell Columbus we're very concerned or this.
sentences.zh: 告诉哥伦布我们对此非常担忧，或者类似的话。

sentences.en: I mean, do they think that he's gone the full Marlon Brando by this point?
sentences.zh: 我是说，他们难道觉得他这时候已经完全像马龙·白兰度那样疯了吗？

sentences.en: Some of the people around them, definitely.
sentences.zh: 他身边的一些人绝对是这么想的。

sentences.en: They're confessors and chaplains and bishops and things.
sentences.zh: 他们是忏悔神父、随军牧师、主教之类的人。

sentences.en: Maybe people who've always distrusted Columbus are saying to them, I mean, it's also such an important thing.
sentences.zh: 也许那些一直不信任哥伦布的人在对他们说，毕竟这事儿太重要了。

sentences.en: I think he's Genoese.
sentences.zh: 我想他是热那亚人。

sentences.en: So, you know, he's a hired gun from a foreign country.
sentences.zh: 所以，他是个来自外国的雇佣兵。

sentences.en: And he's got no one really at court to plead for him.
sentences.zh: 他在宫廷里真的没人能为他辩护。

sentences.en: He's got no network of relatives at court, patrons and all that, who are pleading his case.
sentences.zh: 他没有宫廷亲戚网络、赞助人等等来为他求情。

sentences.en: But he's very good at pleading his own case, isn't he?
sentences.zh: 但他很擅长为自己辩护，不是吗？

sentences.en: He is.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: So he's always able to turn it back when he gets back himself.
sentences.zh: 所以他总能在回到自己地盘时扭转局面。

sentences.en: Kind of end up kind of bending them to his will.
sentences.zh: 最终总能让他们屈服于他的意志。

sentences.en: Well, that's what he decides he has to do.
sentences.zh: 嗯，这就是他决定必须要做的事。

sentences.en: So he ends up thinking, yeah, I've got to go back.
sentences.zh: 所以他最后想，是的，我必须回去。

sentences.en: He does.
sentences.zh: 他确实回去了。

sentences.en: He says to himself, I have to go back.
sentences.zh: 他对自己说，我必须回去。

sentences.en: And then he does something very, very strange, which I think is part of that slight nervous breakdown element.
sentences.zh: 然后他做了一件非常非常奇怪的事，我觉得这属于他那轻微神经崩溃的一部分。

sentences.en: And even historians themselves, you know, who know far more about this than we do, clearly find it baffling.
sentences.zh: 甚至连那些比我们了解得多的历史学家们，显然也觉得这令人费解。

sentences.en: He decides to go back, but he does so.
sentences.zh: 他决定回去，但他采取了这种方式。

sentences.en: He's grown a beard and he's dressing as a Franciscan friar.
sentences.zh: 他留起了胡子，打扮成方济各会修士的样子。

sentences.en: You see, I don't think that's weird at all.
sentences.zh: 你看，我觉得这一点也不奇怪。

sentences.en: Well, I mean, I can't remember which historian it is.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我是说，我不记得是哪位历史学家了。

sentences.en: Maybe Cervantes says a bizarre decision.
sentences.zh: 也许是塞万提斯说这是一个离奇的决定。

sentences.en: I don't think it's bizarre.
sentences.zh: 我不觉得离奇。

sentences.en: I think he's making a statement about himself as, you know, we talked about the symbolic weight of his names, that he's the Christ bearer and he's the dove,
sentences.zh: 我觉得他是在为自己发表某种声明，就像我们之前谈到的他名字的象征意义，他是基督的携带者，他是鸽子，

sentences.en: the embodiment of the spirit.
sentences.zh: 是圣灵的化身。

sentences.en: And that the idea that the world is entering the age of the spirit is particularly associated with the Franciscans.
sentences.zh: 而且世界正在进入圣灵时代的观念，与方济各会特别相关。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: So in that sense, maybe he's casting himself as the vehicle of the Holy Spirit.
sentences.zh: 所以从这个意义上说，也许他把自己塑造成了圣灵的载体。

sentences.en: Well, I think it's definitely PR.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我觉得这绝对是公关手段。

sentences.en: I think he's definitely going back slightly Uriah Heepish, bringing his hands and saying, I'm incredibly humble.
sentences.zh: 我觉得他回去时表现得有点像尤里亚·希普，搓着手说，我极其谦卑。

sentences.en: I'm the servant of the Lord.
sentences.zh: 我是主的仆人。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: So he pitches up in there, in his robes, in his Franciscan outfits.
sentences.zh: 所以他穿着长袍，穿着方济各会的服装出现在那里。

sentences.en: They kind of raise their eyebrows.
sentences.zh: 他们有点挑起眉毛。

sentences.en: But as you say, he's very persuasive.
sentences.zh: 但正如你所说，他非常有说服力。

sentences.en: I mean, it's like kind of very predatory capitalist companies who kind of woke wash.
sentences.zh: 我是说，这就像那些搞“觉醒洗白”的掠夺性资本公司一样。

sentences.en: He's Christian washing him.
sentences.zh: 他在搞“基督洗白”。

sentences.en: He's friar washing.
sentences.zh: 他在搞“修士洗白”。

sentences.en: I mean, you could always tell the most predatory companies because they're always the ones that are most pious, have the most pious advertising.
sentences.zh: 我是说，你总能认出那些最贪婪的公司，因为它们总是最虔诚的，广告也最虔诚。

sentences.en: Ben and Jerry's.
sentences.zh: 比如本杰瑞冰淇淋。

sentences.en: Yeah, exactly.
sentences.zh: 是的，没错。

sentences.en: So that kind of thing.
sentences.zh: 就是那种感觉。

sentences.en: He's the Ben and Jerry's of 15th century exploration.
sentences.zh: 他是15世纪探险界的本杰瑞。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: There's a whole massive metaphor here with fish food.
sentences.zh: 这里有个关于“鱼食”口味的宏大隐喻。

sentences.en: That's my favorite Ben and Jerry's ice cream.
sentences.zh: 那是我最喜欢的本杰瑞冰淇淋口味。

sentences.en: But we won't go in for that.
sentences.zh: 但我们就不深究那个了。

sentences.en: He gets back.
sentences.zh: 他回去了。

sentences.en: He works his magic to some extent.
sentences.zh: 他在某种程度上施展了他的魔法。

sentences.en: So he actually gets permission from them, sort of tentative theoretical permission to go back again, a third voyage, taking more settlers.
sentences.zh: 所以他确实从他们那里得到了许可，某种暂时的、理论上的许可，可以再次出发进行第三次航行，带上更多的定居者。

sentences.en: And they say to him, you have to convert the locals.
sentences.zh: 他们对他说，你必须让当地人皈依。

sentences.en: You know, that's really important.
sentences.zh: 你知道，这真的很重要。

sentences.en: Stop doing all this.
sentences.zh: 别再搞那些乱七八糟的了。

sentences.en: But by this point, he's actually slightly struggling to recruit people because word has spread in the ports of Spain.
sentences.zh: 但到这个时候，他其实在招募人手方面有点困难，因为消息已经在西班牙的港口传开了。

sentences.en: He's a bit mad.
sentences.zh: 他有点疯。

sentences.en: He's very annoying.
sentences.zh: 他非常烦人。

sentences.en: Everything goes wrong.
sentences.zh: 一切都搞砸了。

sentences.en: So actually, for a time, he's becalmed.
sentences.zh: 所以实际上，有一段时间他陷入了停滞。

sentences.en: And in that time, he's writing increasingly weird things about how it's definitely Asia, how evil words have been spread about him.
sentences.zh: 在那段时间里，他写了一些越来越奇怪的东西，说那绝对是亚洲，说有人散布关于他的恶毒言论。

sentences.en: And he's starting to make these strange comparisons.
sentences.zh: 他开始做这些奇怪的类比。

sentences.en: He's digging out things from the Bible and saying there have been prophecies about a place called Tarshish.
sentences.zh: 他从《圣经》里翻出东西，说关于一个叫他施的地方有预言。

sentences.en: Do you know what Tarshish is?
sentences.zh: 你知道他施是什么地方吗？

sentences.en: Yeah, Tarshish is a place in Spain that is associated with gold and silver.
sentences.zh: 是的，他施是西班牙的一个地方，与金银贸易有关。

sentences.en: Well, he's sort of digging up all stuff about this and he's saying this is foretold.
sentences.zh: 嗯，他翻出了所有关于这个的东西，说这是预言好的。

sentences.en: He's very interested in Solomon.
sentences.zh: 他对所罗门非常感兴趣。

sentences.en: So he sometimes says that the Caribbean, these are probably places that traded with Solomon.
sentences.zh: 所以他有时说加勒比海，这些地方很可能就是与所罗门进行贸易的地方。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And then other times, he says, I'm actually King David and Ferdinand is Solomon.
sentences.zh: 而另一些时候，他说，我其实是大卫王，而费尔南多是所罗门。

sentences.en: That's the analogy.
sentences.zh: 这就是类比。

sentences.en: I'm laying the foundations.
sentences.zh: 我在奠定基础。

sentences.en: I mean, when you're comparing yourself with David, I mean, Jesus obviously did that and got away with it.
sentences.zh: 我是说，当你把自己和大卫相比时，耶稣显然做过，而且没出事。

sentences.en: But Columbus is not.
sentences.zh: 但哥伦布不是耶稣。

sentences.en: Well, he didn't, did he?
sentences.zh: 嗯，他没能成功，不是吗？

sentences.en: No, he didn't, actually.
sentences.zh: 不，他确实没成功。

sentences.en: He didn't get away with it.
sentences.zh: 他没能全身而退。

sentences.en: Jesus tried that and didn't get away with it.
sentences.zh: 耶稣试过那样做，但没能全身而退。

sentences.en: And Columbus, well, he wasn't crucified.
sentences.zh: 而哥伦布，嗯，他没被钉死在十字架上。

sentences.en: No, he wasn't crucified.
sentences.zh: 不，他没被钉死。

sentences.en: So actually, it's a plus for Columbus.
sentences.zh: 所以实际上，这对哥伦布来说是个加分项。

sentences.en: So we should leave Columbus there.
sentences.zh: 所以我们应该把哥伦布留在那里。

sentences.en: He's in Spain.
sentences.zh: 他在西班牙。

sentences.en: He wants to do another voyage.
sentences.zh: 他想再进行一次航行。

sentences.en: Which is slightly bonkers.
sentences.zh: 这有点疯狂。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: Everything has gone wrong.
sentences.zh: 一切都搞砸了。

sentences.en: And we should do a fourth episode, shouldn't we, Tom?
sentences.zh: 我们应该做第四集，对吧，汤姆？

sentences.en: Where we talk about his third and fourth voyages, which in some ways is less consequential, but a matter.
sentences.zh: 我们谈谈他的第三次和第四次航行，在某些方面这不太重要，但很重要。

sentences.en: Stranger things happen.
sentences.zh: 更奇怪的事情发生了。

sentences.en: Full of brilliant details.
sentences.zh: 充满了精彩的细节。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Including an extraordinary metaphor for the shape of the globe that Columbus comes up with after he's been a long time at sea.
sentences.zh: 包括哥伦布在海上漂泊很久后，对地球形状提出的一个非凡的隐喻。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: A slightly not safe for work metaphor, I think it's fair to say.
sentences.zh: 我觉得可以公平地说，那是一个稍微有点不适合在工作场合说的隐喻。

sentences.en: Plus, there's some heroic canoeing, which is always good in a podcaSt.
sentences.zh: 另外，还有一些英勇的划独木舟情节，这在播客里总是很棒的。

sentences.en: And we shall be debating, won't we, where Columbus stands in history and what we make of him.
sentences.zh: 我们将会讨论，不是吗，哥伦布在历史上处于什么位置，以及我们如何看待他。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: A hero or villain.
sentences.zh: 英雄还是恶棍。

sentences.en: Well, would we ever be so simplistic, Tom?
sentences.zh: 嗯，我们会那么简单地看待吗，汤姆？

sentences.en: Who knows?
sentences.zh: 谁知道呢？

sentences.en: Find out.
sentences.zh: 拭目以待。

sentences.zh: 现在，《余下的历史》的长期听众会确切地知道我现在要说什么了。

sentences.zh: 现在，如果你是《余下的历史》俱乐部的成员，也就是我心目中的船员，你现在就可以收听那一集了。

sentences.en: And if you're not, well, you can subscribe right now.
sentences.zh: 如果你还不是，嗯，你现在就可以订阅。

sentences.zh: 只需前往 Apple Podcasts，《余下的历史》频道，进行免费试用，或访问 restishistorypod.com。

sentences.zh: 加入我们的航行。

sentences.zh: 我们没疯。

sentences.en: And is that the right analogy to comparing ourselves with Columbus?
sentences.zh: 把我们自己和哥伦布相比，这个类比合适吗？
